cli.description: A CLI tool that takes you from source code to a fully running local Kubernetes environment
cli.initDescription: Create kustron-env.yaml in the current folder
cli.upDescription: Bring up the environment and deploy all apps
cli.reloadDescription: Down + up (pick up any yaml changes)
cli.addDescription: Add a new app entry to kustron-env.yaml
cli.removeDescription: Remove an app entry from kustron-env.yaml
cli.sourceOption: Local path or git SSH/HTTPS URL
cli.haOption: HA mode: min 2, max 5 replicas, CPU 90%, mem 80%

init.alreadyExists: kustron-env.yaml already exists. Edit it directly or use `kustron apps add` to add apps.
init.nextStep: Open it, set the port, and run `kustron env up`.

up.noEnvFile: No kustron-env.yaml found. Run `kustron env init` to create one.

down.confirm: Are you sure you want to tear down cluster '{{name}}'?
down.notFound: Cluster '{{name}}' not found. Nothing to do.

add.exactlyOneSource: Exactly one of --source, --image, or --helm-chart is required.
add.portRequired: --port is required for source and image apps.
add.reloadHint: Run `kustron env reload` to apply changes.

remove.reloadHint: Run `kustron env reload` to apply changes.

checks.missingRequiredError: Missing required dependencies. Please install them and try again.
checks.optionalMissing: Optional dependencies missing: {{deps}}. Some features may be unavailable.

deploy.rolloutFailed: Rollout failed — see pod describe / logs below for details.
deploy.helmExposureWarning: Cannot expose helm app '{{name}}' without a selector. Add `helm.selector` to kustron-env.yaml and run `kustron env reload`.
deploy.gitAccessDenied: Cannot access '{{url}}'. Please set up SSH access to your Git provider and try again.

errors.dockerNotRunning: Docker does not appear to be running. Start Docker/OrbStack and try again.
errors.railpackMissing: Railpack is required to build this app but is not installed. Install it from https://railpack.io or add a Dockerfile to your project.
